name: Infisical
summary: Infisical is an open-source secrets, identity, and access-management platform for development teams and enterprise infrastructure.
overview: Infisical provides developer infrastructure for managing application secrets and configuration.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Led by Elad Gil; disclosed total funding is $19.3M. The valuation was not disclosed.

bull_case: Secrets, identities and machine credentials are critical infrastructure for AI-era software. An open-source platform can compound through developer adoption and expand into higher-value security workflows.
bear_case: Security infrastructure is a crowded category with established incumbents. Infisical must convert developer usage into durable enterprise deployments while maintaining a strong security posture.
latest_round: June 2025: $16M Series A; $19.3M total funding reported
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: Infisical provides developer infrastructure for managing application secrets and configuration.

metrics.label: Latest valuation
metrics.note: Valuation was not announced with the June 2025 Series A

company: Infisical began as an open-source secrets-management project and has expanded into a security stack for secrets, identity and access. Its products include PKI, SSH and key-management capabilities alongside its core secrets workflow.

In June 2025, Infisical announced a $16M Series A led by Elad Gil. The company said it was cash-flow positive and securing workloads for Fortune 50 enterprises; those operating statements are company-reported.
intelligence.why_it_matters: AI systems increase the number of credentials, services and agents that need secure access. Infisical is a private-market test of whether an open-source developer foothold can expand into a broad enterprise-security platform.

takeaways: Infisical combines secrets management with PKI, SSH and key-management capabilities.
The company announced a $16M Series A led by Elad Gil and did not disclose a valuation.
Enterprise conversion, security assurance and platform expansion are the key watch items.
